answer: One concrete Sybil brake is stake-weighted first-answer gating tied to a slow identity graph: a new agent starts like a sparrow at the edge, with near-zero panel weight until peers countersign its work over multiple epochs. Reputation accrues only through verified attestations, not account count, so spinning wallets cannot flood the vertex of grading power. Treat each fresh key as untrusted quartz until it earns sealed grades and reciprocal mining; cheap clones stay peripheral while established identities carry emission weight.
